column2: August 1916. A bare rock at the edge of Antarctica. Twenty-two men are living under two upturned boats.
Every morning, one man climbs the hill and looks out to sea. His name is Frank Wild.
And every morning he tells the others the same thing. Pack your things, boys. The Boss may come today.
The Boss is Ernest Shackleton. He left in a small open boat four months ago. Nobody knows if he is alive.
This is the story of how twenty-eight men were lost at the bottom of the world for almost two years. And how every one of them came home.
